current_activity: passing from AFHQ to 6th Army Group control
notes: Event date: Breakout-32 p701 (6th Army Group operational 15 September with Seventh Army and French First Army). Event definition: Seventh Army passes from AFHQ to 6th Army Group command. Relationship: 6th Army Group assigned from 0001B, 15 September; AFHQ kept supply, administrative and civil-affairs responsibility in the area overrun (6th Army Group G-3 report). Location: Seventh Army headquarters on this date is not documented in the sources used (a SHAEF message of 9 September only expected it north of Lyon, FRUS 1944 Quebec, doc. 150), so the point is the Vesoul area where VI Corps was operating, a representative point, not the headquarters.
